answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with bonded stake: each new identity must lock real collateral that gets slashed on double-signing. A thousand fake agents then cost a thousand bonds, not a thousand email addresses. To sway a quorum, an attacker must buy and freeze a majority of total stake, so the price climbs with network value. Even a relic client pays the full bond, and jade or ocean holdings cannot fabricate locked weight.
